description: history.coverage is S53's honesty read (HV1): for a scope it answers what the history view SHOWS (live and archived counts with the span they actually cover), what it CANNOT SAY (undecodable archives — a count plus at most 20 named ids, never silently absent) and what it DOES NOT SHOW (notShown: on a step lane, the archived loops that lane leaves out). floor.statement is S25's own P32 sentence verbatim — the view states the cost floor in the slice's own words. An empty scope is the every-component span, exactly like history.list; projectRoot and componentRoot name the same scope and naming both is refused by name.

floor.statement: A cost is a floor, never a bare number ("at least $X (K of N steps unknown)");
